image_alt: A whippet in a red collar lies on the grass on a lead beside a wide river under a blue sky.

text.facebook: From 1 November, owners of XL Bullies and other banned breeds in England and Wales must not leave a child under 12 in close contact with their dog at home or in the garden without an adult present. Defra says cameras and baby monitors don't count. Its advice works for any dog: plan for the moments supervision slips, like cooking or answering the door, and use a stair gate or a quiet room. What the rule says: https://www.foresthounds.co.uk/blog/banned-breeds-children-rule
